subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 3 – Lesson 1: Vocabulary – Places and buildings
outcomes: I can name twelve places and buildings, like castle and skyscraper.
I can guess a place from a description.
I can say why some places are important to people.

tf.s: Big boats stop at a harbour.
tf.why: A harbour is where boats and ships stop.

tf.s: A skyscraper is a very small, old house.
tf.why: A skyscraper is a very tall, modern building.

tf.s: Doctors and nurses work in a hospital.
tf.why: People go to a hospital when they are ill.

tf.s: A king or queen lives in a factory.
tf.why: A king or queen lives in a palace.

tf.s: A factory is a place where people make things, like chocolate.
tf.why: Workers make things in a factory.

tf.s: A stadium is a place for big sports matches.
tf.why: Lots of people watch matches in a stadium.

tf.s: People live in an office building.
tf.why: People work in an office building; they live in an apartment building.

tf.s: In the word skyscraper, the stress is on SKY.
Some places are important because they tell us about history.
tf.why: A castle or fort can tell us about the past.

tf.s: A swimming pool is a place where you can climb mountains.
tf.why: You swim in a swimming pool.

boxes.q: What is a very tall, modern building?
Where does a king or queen live?
boxes.why: Kings and queens live in palaces.

boxes.q: Where can you see how to make chocolate?
boxes.why: Things like chocolate are made in a factory.
You do sports at a sports centre.

boxes.q: Which is an Omani example of a harbour?
“It’s the tallest building in the city. There’s a café at the top.” What is it?
boxes.why: The tallest building is a skyscraper.

boxes.q: Where is the stress in hospital?
“You can swim here. It has blue water.” What is it?
boxes.why: You swim in a swimming pool.

hunt.q: A king or queen lives here
An old building with thick walls

mcq.q: Which place has kind doctors and nurses?
mcq.why: Doctors and nurses work in a hospital.

mcq.q: Which group of places is all for sport?
mcq.why: We do or watch sports in these places.

mcq.q: What is the WOW! Question of Unit 3?
o: Why are some places and buildings important to us?
mcq.why: Unit 3 is about places and why they matter.

mcq.q: Which is an old building in Oman that tells us about history?
mcq.why: Nizwa castle is an important historic place.

mcq.q: Which group of places is all for working?
mcq.why: People have jobs in factories, offices and hospitals.

mcq.q: Choose the correct sentence about a town.
o: There’s a big hospital near my house.
There’s a big hospital near my house swim.
There a big hospital near my house.
There’s big hospitals near my house.

mcq.q: “I stayed there with my family. We could see the sea and the boats.” Which place is near?
mcq.why: Boats and the sea mean a harbour.

mcq.q: Why might a castle be important to people?
o: It tells us about history and people have memories there.
It is a place to buy food.
mcq.why: Old buildings connect us with the past.

mcq.q: Which word is the odd one out?
mcq.why: A harbour is for boats; the others are kinds of buildings.

mcq.q: Which is the best two-clue description of a stadium?
o: You watch big matches here. Thousands of people sit here.
You sleep here. It has a kitchen.
Boats stop here. It is near the sea.
You make chocolate here. It has machines.
